name: Surface Analysis, Spectroscopy & Scanning Probes
summary: Covers techniques that measure surface chemistry, bonding and topography: XPS, Auger, SIMS, vibrational spectroscopy and scanning probe microscopy.

topics.name: Why surfaces need special techniques: information depth and ultra-high vacuum
X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS): chemical states and depth profiling
Secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) and ToF-SIMS
Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy of polymers and surfaces
Raman spectroscopy: phase identification, stress and carbon materials
Atomic force microscopy: contact, tapping and force spectroscopy modes
Kelvin probe, magnetic force and conductive AFM
Contact angle and surface energy measurement
